q: Does Attribix work with Shopify and WooCommerce?
a: Yes: Shopify and WooCommerce are both supported. Connect your store and start streaming events.

q: How do you track conversions accurately?
a: Attribix combines browser-side and server-side conversion signals. Meta CAPI uses matching parameters and event deduplication; Google Ads uses its own conversion and transaction-ID mechanisms. Each platform's own method is used to avoid double-counting.
Last-click, first-click, linear and time-decay: compare them directly in your attribution dashboard, with last-click, first-click or linear available as your account's default model in Settings.

Attribix supports Google Consent Mode v2, and implements the data-request and deletion webhooks Shopify requires of every app. See our Privacy Policy for full details on what's collected and how it's handled.

q: How do refunds, tax and shipping affect revenue?
a: Revenue is captured from your Shopify order total at the time of purchase. It doesn't automatically re-adjust if an order is later refunded or edited, so for periods with significant refund activity, cross-check against Shopify's own reporting.
